blind.description: A bone-themed three-candle candelabrum featuring a base formed from outward-facing carved human skulls, an ornate central spine/bone stem, and three candle cups holding cream-colored wax candles with unlit black wicks. The surfaces are continuous, cleanly modeled, and fully solid without visible geometry defects.
blind.from_above: From directly above, it appears as three aligned round candle tops running vertically over a symmetrical cross-shaped base formed by the four skull brows.
blind.height_vs_figure: About one-quarter of the figure's height (roughly 1.3 to 1.5 ft tall) and around 8 to 10 inches wide.
